title: Store-and-forward /msg/store unimplemented: limits table, eviction policy, back-pressure codes, delivery flow (spec 18.1.4)
description: Spec 12-apps.md 18.1.4: store-and-forward is OPTIONAL but implementations that support it MUST comply with the limits table (min 8 msgs / 2 per-dest / 128 B / 1 KB / TTL 1 h), MUST support at least the minimum values; eviction order expired, then per-destination fair share, then FIFO; back-pressure 5.03 storage_full CBOR / 4.13 / 4.03 blacklisted / 4.00 TTL; delivery flow routing query, FIFO, ACK-gated, retain on failure, delete on success; capability advertised via /.well-known/core rt=msg.store. Classification: not-implemented in all stacks (feature is MAY; no /msg/store or rt=msg.store anywhere). Evidence: strings only in spec/12-apps.md:141-143,189; closest analogs are the routing DTN buffer (C dtn.h:31-49 64 KB/32 msgs/1280 B/24 h, coap_dtn.c) and /deaddrop (Py deaddrop.py:619-629 storage_full body) with different limits; per-destination fair-share eviction absent everywhere (FIFO only: C coap_msg.c:248-253, Py messaging.py:277-279); delivery-flow primitives unwired (C lichen_router_dtn_retrieve router.c:1232, Py dtn_retrieve_for router.py:839, Rs rust/lichen-node/src/routing/dtn.rs:110 - zero production callers). Suggested placement: decide whether /msg/store is implemented as specified or /deaddrop is declared the S&F mechanism and spec amended; then limits/eviction/back-pressure per stack. Refs R-12-011, R-12-012, R-12-013, R-12-015, R-12-016, R-12-019.
